description: Capabilities granted to the always-on-top overlay. Narrower than the main window's by a wide margin: the overlay shows three numbers and moves itself, so it gets dragging, cursor pass-through, always-on-top, hide, close and the event channel that carries frames — no store, no filesystem, no dialogs, no process control. A chromeless window floating above everything is the easiest surface here to mistake for something it is not.
